blogPosts.title: How to Prevent Blocked Drains in Surrey Hills Kitchens
blogPosts.excerpt: Practical tips to keep your Surrey Hills kitchen drains clear, from proper waste disposal to regular cleaning, with advice from Stavco Plumbing experts.
body: Blocked drains are a common issue in Surrey Hills kitchens, often caused by improper waste disposal. Grease, food scraps, and debris can accumulate, leading to slow drainage or backups. Stavco Plumbing recommends using drain strainers and disposing of waste in bins to prevent blockages.

Pouring hot water down drains periodically helps dissolve grease buildup, but avoid harsh chemicals that can damage pipes. In Surrey Hills, where older plumbing systems may be present, gentle methods are safer. Our plumbers advise a monthly flush with boiling water and bicarbonate soda for maintenance.

Understanding the local plumbing infrastructure is key; Surrey Hills' sewer systems can be affected by tree roots or silt accumulation. Regular inspections with CCTV cameras by Stavco Plumbing can identify issues early, allowing for cleaning or minor repairs before major blockages occur.

Australian building codes emphasise proper drainage to prevent environmental contamination. Ensuring your kitchen plumbing is compliant not only avoids blockages but also supports sustainability. Stavco Plumbing uses eco-friendly practices in drain cleaning, respecting Surrey Hills' community standards.
